p: Cricklewood Broadway is part of the old Edgware Road, the long straight Roman route out of London, and it's a busy, mixed stretch of cafés, grocers, pubs and takeaways serving a real cross-section of north-west London.

Admiral is an adults-only gaming centre, so it's strictly for over-18s. If you want a breather nearby, Gladstone Park is a short walk away and has great views back across London from the top of the hill. The Thameslink trains from Cricklewood station make it quick to get into central London or out towards St Albans, and Brent Cross is only a few minutes up the road for bigger shopping trips. Plenty of choice for food on the Broadway itself, from Irish pubs to Middle Eastern grills.
